description: This file defines the ApplyChecksumMiddleware class used within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for S3 operations. It manages the application of checksum headers to requests, supporting algorithms like SHA256, MD5, and CRC32, and handles checksum validation and headers for S3 requests.

classes.name: ApplyChecksumMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware for applying and validating checksum headers on AWS S3 requests, supporting multiple algorithms and ensuring request integrity.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Creates a wrapper function that encapsulates the middleware, binding it with the specified Service API object.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the middleware with the next handler and the AWS Service API object.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Main method invoked during request processing; applies checksum headers based on command parameters and operation specifications.

methods.name: addAlgorithmHeader
methods.description: Adds a specific algorithm checksum header to the request, encoding the checksum value appropriately.

methods.name: isS3Express
methods.description: Determines whether the command is for the S3Express signing service, affecting checksum handling.
